paragraphs.text: Jennifer "Tifa" Robles , née Jennifer Meyen is a former employee from Wizards of the Coast . She worked in Game Support & Customer Service in 2011, and as Assistant Brand Manager for Magic: The Gathering from 2012 to 2013.
She was founder and organizer for the Lady Planeswalkers Society , and a cohost on the DailyMTG.com Podcast with Trick Jarrett and her husband Michael Robles.
As a storyline author, she contributed to the Uncharted Realms for Theros .
